facts.business: Sunil Agro Foods Limited is engaged in the food processing industry in India.

auditor.name: Not specified in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Company has not made provisions for Bad debt of Rs 97.57 lakhs in case of one debtor Maiyas Beverage and Foods Private Limited which was referred to NCLT under Indian Bankruptcy Code. As per NCLT order only 15.14% amount is payable to all the Sundry Creditors. Due to this Company's Profit and Sundry debtors are overstated by Rs.97.57 lakhs.

key_risks: Non-provisioning for bad debt of Rs 97.57 lakhs from a debtor under NCLT proceedings leading to overstatement of profit and sundry debtors
High volume, low unit value inventory dispersed across different points of sale posing valuation and existence risks
